description: Header file defining the CordRepRing class, which implements a ring buffer for string representations in the Abseil library. Contains class declarations, inline methods, and detailed comments on usage and internal structure.

classes.name: CordRepRing
classes.description: A class implementing a ring buffer for string data, supporting append, prepend, subring, removal, and iteration operations with internal position tracking.

classes.name: CordRep::Position
classes.description: A struct representing a position within the ring buffer, including node index and offset.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new ring buffer from a child CordRep, adopting its reference.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends string data or a CordRep child to the ring buffer.

methods.name: Prepend
methods.description: Prepends string data or a CordRep child to the ring buffer.

methods.name: SubRing
methods.description: Returns a subring of the current ring buffer starting at offset with specified length.

methods.name: RemoveSuffix
methods.description: Removes bytes from the end of the ring buffer.

methods.name: RemovePrefix
methods.description: Removes bytes from the beginning of the ring buffer.

methods.name: GetCharacter
methods.description: Returns the character at a specific offset.

methods.name: IsFlat
methods.description: Checks if the ring buffer is a single contiguous buffer.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Finds the position corresponding to a byte offset.

methods.name: FindTail
methods.description: Finds the tail position for a given offset.
